trace.observation:
{"id": 252, "title": "Deposition pack — Scheduling order excerpt: discovery cutoff", "doc_type": "court_order", "related_shape": "deposition-management", "body": "SCHEDULING ORDER (excerpt)

2. FACT DISCOVERY. All fact discovery, INCLUDING depositions, shall be COMPLETED by FRIDAY, OCTOBER 30, 2026. 'Completed' means the deposition has been taken, not merely noticed.

2.1 A deposition notice served on a party must be served at least 14 DAYS before the deposition date.

2.2 A non-party witness may be compelled only by SUBPOENA under Rule 45; a notice alone has no effect on a non-party.

2.3 No deposition may be scheduled after the fact-discovery cutoff absent a stipulation approved by the Court."}

{"id": 254, "title": "Deposition pack — Availability memo", "doc_type": "availability_memo", "related_shape": "deposition-management", "body": "AVAILABILITY MEMO

J. Ellery is available on: 2026-10-12, 2026-10-19, and 2026-11-06.
Counsel for the defendant is available on all three dates.
Our trial team is available on all three dates.

Note from the paralegal: the client would prefer the latest possible date to allow document review to finish."}

arguments.rationale: 2026-11-06 falls after the October 30 fact-discovery cutoff and is unavailable absent a court-approved stipulation; the latest compliant date is October 19, 2026.
